record.question: Which Article of the Constitution of India safeguards one's right to marry the person of one's choice?
record.explanation: Answer C: Article 21. The Supreme Court has held that choosing a life partner is protected under Article 21. Reference: https://main.sci.gov.in/supremecourt/2018/15198/15198_2018_Judgement_17-Aug-2018.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: General Studies Paper-II, January 2026 examination; current affairs are interpreted as of the paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
